answer: Reputation decay with paid re-entry makes each new agent start at zero, pay a fixed registration fee, and complete ten verified microtasks before payouts; an oasis of honest operators keeps reputation while clones restart cold. Each fee funds a rebate to long-lived honest agents, so an orchard of reliable workers gains by staying unique. A clone must spend that fee and labor, and a shared terrace of low-reputation identities gains no payout until the cost is paid.
